oracle.scope: 17.c.W supplies the pure field engine for three present JSON resource values: recursive disjoint object changes, identical JSON targets, one-sided changes and explicit member absence. Equality uses the existing JCS value contract, not Python bool/number coercion. Conflicts retain all original observations and block target access. An actual native source/inventory fixture proves that computing a candidate does not approve or mutate the inventory. This is an internal value API, not a new stored merge-plan format. Schema-aware collections/attachments, identity/history, profile/invariant and final-target validation, persisted conflicts/resolutions, CLI/Work and publication remain later M17 gates. Concurrent arrays without those semantics remain explicitly unresolved. No complete requirement or M17 success is claimed.

preconditions: Three present, owned JSON values of the same logical resource; missing members are observed by actual key absence.
Prepared behavior tests execute only in the stage-specific Apply gate; Dev collection is not test evidence.
steps: Merge explicit nested disjoint changes and JSON-equivalent targets; compare against independent exact expected values.
Observe every conflicting source value with its presence and RFC-6901 pointer; reject target access while unresolved.
Load actual native source bytes and retain their inventory/source bindings without writing or granting merge authority.
